SELECT
  SUM(line_revenue) AS total_sales_inr
FROM (
  SELECT
    oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_inr * (
      1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0
    ) AS line_revenue
  FROM order_items AS oi
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE
    o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')
) AS subquery
